title: Join the December webinar for an inside look at the PEGASUS Framework!
summary: 💡Curious about community standards for reporting predicted effector genes from GWAS and integrative evidence? Want to benchmark your own results and see how they stack up?
bodyHtml:
💡Curious about community standards for reporting predicted effector genes from GWAS and integrative evidence? Want to benchmark your own results and see how they stack up?

🔬 The PEGASUS Framework offers a FAIR, community-driven approach to harmonizing metadata, evidence matrices, and effector gene predictions. Whether you're generating predictions or evaluating them, this webinar will help you level up your analyses and contribute to a growing collaborative standard.

ℹ️ What you’ll gain:

  • A walkthrough of the PEGASUS Framework
  • How to apply FAIR, unified reporting standards
  • Guidance on benchmarking your own results
  • A chance to share feedback and experiences with the community

📅 Thursday, December 11th, 2025
🕛 12:00–1:00 PM ET

🔗 Join the webinar: Passcode 363662

📁 See results of the Predicted Effector Gene (PEGASUS) Workshop as part of ASHG 2025 here.

🧬 Let’s build stronger, more transparent gene prediction standards together!
